failures.error: Apple libtool was invoked with ar qc arguments and reported no output file specified
failures.cause: CMAKE_C_CREATE_STATIC_LIBRARY provided to the outer configure was not propagated to try_compile
failures.fix: Use ios-libtool.cmake through CMAKE_USER_MAKE_RULES_OVERRIDE and run a C/C++ archive preflight before dependency downloads

failures.phase: Target LLVM CMake configuration, after successful archive preflight and host TableGen build
failures.error: install TARGETS given no BUNDLE DESTINATION for MACOSX_BUNDLE executable target llvm-tblgen (also lld and Clang CLI targets)
failures.cause: CMake's iOS platform defaults CMAKE_MACOSX_BUNDLE to ON, but LLVM auxiliary command-line targets use RUNTIME install destinations
failures.fix: Set CMAKE_MACOSX_BUNDLE=OFF for native dependency builds and include an excluded CLI install target in the early preflight
